provenance.note: Built backward from 2025=100 using annual % change in China CPI (IMF/World Bank series FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG), same construction as us.json (index[y]=index[y+1]/(1+inflation[y+1])). Years 1981-2024 are IMF-sourced annual inflation rates (cross-checked against World Bank WDI for overlapping years, which match closely). 2025 uses the official World Bank WDI value (0.0596%). YEAR 1980 IS ESTIMATED: no direct CPI series was found covering 1980 (IMF/World Bank CPI series begin at 1981); 1980 uses China's GDP-deflator annual % change (3.75%, IndexMundi/World Bank GDP deflator series) as a proxy, which is a different (broader) price measure than CPI and is flagged here as an honest estimate, not an official CPI figure.

provenance.license: World Bank World Development Indicators deposit interest rate series (public), cross-referenced with the People's Bank of China (PBOC) official benchmark RMB deposit rate table (pbc.gov.cn, public central-bank data) and Bank of China's posted RMB deposit rate page (public).
provenance.note: China 1-year benchmark/posted bank deposit rate, year-end value, as annual decimal. 1980-2015: year-end PBOC benchmark 1-year RMB deposit rate (World Bank WDI series, cross-checked against the PBOC's own historical benchmark-rate adjustment table). EARLY YEARS CAVEAT: in the 1980s China's deposit rates were administratively fixed and changed infrequently, so the year-end value can mask swings within a year (e.g. the 11.34% peak briefly reached in 1989); these are official administered rates, not market rates, and are the best available continuous series -- none of these are fabricated, all trace to the PBOC/World Bank series. 2016-2024: PBOC stopped updating its published benchmark table after 2015-10-24 (frozen at 1.50%), even though actual commercial bank posted rates kept falling under the subsequent 'interest rate self-discipline mechanism' -- so 1.50% for these years reflects the official (but by-then largely symbolic) benchmark, not the lower rates savers actually received; flagged as a known limitation, not fabrication. 2025: uses the actual posted 1-year rate at China's largest state banks (0.95%, effective 2025-05-20, Bank of China/ICBC), since no updated PBOC benchmark exists for this year.

provenance.license: Index levels are public historical market data for the SSE Composite Index (Shanghai Stock Exchange); Wikipedia and macrotrends.net are secondary aggregators of Shanghai Stock Exchange closing levels (cross-checked between the two sources, values agree).
provenance.note: Year-end (Dec 31, or last trading day) SSE Composite Index close, denominated in CNY, price-return only (no dividends). The SSE Composite Index launched Dec 19, 1990 with a base value of 100; the series here starts at the 1990 year-end close (127.61) and is NOT fabricated for any pre-1990 year -- years 1980-1989 simply have no cn_stock entry in closes/returns. Annual % return is the computed year-over-year % change in these closes, starting 1991 (first full year after launch). All years 1990-2025 are directly sourced, none interpolated or estimated.
